figurative_meaning_en: To read palms or practice palmistry
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভবিষ্যৎ জানার জন্য সে একজন কবিরাজের কাছে হাত দেখাতে গেল।
বিয়ের আগে অনেকে হাত দেখিয়ে ভাগ্য নির্ধারণ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: To know her future, she went to a palmist to have her hand read.
Many people get their palms read before marriage to determine their fate.
history: This idiom stems from ancient palmistry traditions prevalent in South Asian cultures, including Bengal, where hand lines are believed to reveal destiny.
note: Common in traditional Bengali society for predicting life events.
